purpose: Shared business semantic schema for policy extraction, connected knowledge and request assessment.

Customer.label: Customer
Customer.definition: A person or organization with a banking relationship.

Borrower.label: Borrower
Borrower.definition: A customer seeking or receiving credit; a specialized Customer.

LoanApplication.label: Loan application
LoanApplication.definition: A request for credit, distinct from an originated loan.

Loan.label: Loan
Loan.definition: An originated credit agreement or facility.

CreditPolicy.label: Credit policy
CreditPolicy.definition: A stable policy identity across separately identified versions.

PolicyVersion.label: Policy version
PolicyVersion.definition: An immutable, source-bound version of a credit policy.

PolicySection.label: Policy section
PolicySection.definition: A section of one policy version, optionally nested within another section.

PolicyRule.label: Policy rule
PolicyRule.definition: A source-derived normative requirement within exactly one policy version.

requirement_text.description: Exact operative source statement, including qualitative duties.

Condition.label: Condition
Condition.definition: A typed comparison used in scope, eligibility or exception logic.

ConditionGroup.label: Condition group
ConditionGroup.definition: An explicit AND, OR or NOT expression over conditions or nested groups.

Threshold.label: Threshold
Threshold.definition: A numerical boundary with an operator and unit, measured against exactly one metric.

CustomerSegment.label: Customer segment
CustomerSegment.definition: A controlled grouping of customers, such as SME; no numerical SME definition is assumed.

Product.label: Product
Product.definition: A controlled credit product or facility type.

Geography.label: Geography
Geography.definition: A jurisdiction or geographic grouping used in explicit policy scope.

RiskMetric.label: Risk metric
RiskMetric.definition: A defined quantitative measure with declared permitted units and optional formula.

Exception.label: Exception
Exception.definition: A conditional deviation from one base rule. Approval and alternative rules are explicit links.

ApprovalRequirement.label: Approval requirement
ApprovalRequirement.definition: A required decision by an identified authority; this is not an approval already granted.

ApprovalAuthority.label: Approval authority
ApprovalAuthority.definition: An accountable role or committee empowered to make a specified decision.

EvidenceRequirement.label: Evidence requirement
EvidenceRequirement.definition: A required evidence type and optional freshness condition.

ControlEvidence.label: Control evidence
ControlEvidence.definition: An actual evidence artifact with its recorded verification state.

EffectivePeriod.label: Effective period
EffectivePeriod.definition: An inclusive start date and optional inclusive end date; absent period means unknown validity.

SourcePassage.label: Source passage
SourcePassage.definition: Exact evidence text, source identity, version and checksum; never a generated policy summary.

TaxonomyConcept.label: Taxonomy concept
TaxonomyConcept.definition: A reference to a controlled classification concept; classification is distinct from executable applicability.

DataAttribute.label: Data attribute
DataAttribute.definition: An exact source-system or workbook attribute; bindings require separate governance.

Party.label: Party
Party.definition: A person, organization, or group with a role in a credit relationship.

LegalEntity.label: Legal entity
LegalEntity.definition: An independently constituted organization that can be a parent entity.

Counterparty.label: Counterparty
Counterparty.definition: A party on the other side of a credit transaction.

Guarantor.label: Guarantor
Guarantor.definition: A party that provides a guarantee.

Sponsor.label: Sponsor
Sponsor.definition: A party that supports a borrower or a financed transaction.

Tenant.label: Tenant
Tenant.definition: A party leasing financed or pledged property.

CreditRequest.label: Credit request
CreditRequest.definition: A request for one or more credit facilities.

Facility.label: Facility
Facility.definition: A requested or committed credit arrangement.

Country.label: Country
Country.definition: A country identified under an explicit geographic code scheme.

Jurisdiction.label: Jurisdiction
Jurisdiction.definition: A territory under a particular legal or regulatory authority.

BookingLocation.label: Booking location
BookingLocation.definition: The office or location where a facility is booked.

Industry.label: Industry
Industry.definition: An economic classification of a party or financed activity.

Subsector.label: Subsector
Subsector.definition: A finer economic classification within a sector.

BusinessActivity.label: Business activity
BusinessActivity.definition: An economic activity conducted by a party or financed by a facility.

BorrowerType.label: Borrower type
BorrowerType.definition: A classification used for borrower eligibility.

Exposure.label: Exposure
Exposure.definition: A credit exposure measured at the applicable entity and reporting scope.

Collateral.label: Collateral
Collateral.definition: An asset or security pledged against credit.

Guarantee.label: Guarantee
Guarantee.definition: A commitment by a guarantor to support an obligation.

Tenor.label: Tenor
Tenor.definition: The duration of a facility in months.

Currency.label: Currency
Currency.definition: The currency in which a credit amount is denominated.

Purpose.label: Purpose
Purpose.definition: The stated intended use of funding.

RiskAttribute.label: Risk attribute
RiskAttribute.definition: A qualitative or quantitative characteristic used in credit-risk analysis.

CreditRating.label: Credit rating
CreditRating.definition: An observed credit rating under an identified rating type.

RiskGrade.label: Risk grade
RiskGrade.definition: A grade assigned under a risk classification scale.

RiskObservation.label: Risk observation
RiskObservation.definition: An observed deal risk value with the unit supplied by its source.

PolicyClass.label: Policy class
PolicyClass.definition: A policy category or topic in the current policy taxonomy.

PolicyConcern.label: Policy concern
PolicyConcern.definition: A source-backed subject or dependency used to navigate rules.

IndustryTier.label: Industry tier
IndustryTier.definition: A risk tier assigned to an industry under the relevant classification.

OperationalEvidence.label: Operational evidence
OperationalEvidence.definition: A source reference for a deal fact or an assessment output.

RuleAssessment.label: Rule assessment
RuleAssessment.definition: An evaluation of a specific credit request against a specific policy rule.

DecisionOutcome.label: Decision outcome
DecisionOutcome.definition: The recorded result of a rule assessment.

HAS_APPLICABILITY.label: has applicability
HAS_APPLICABILITY.definition: Source-backed scope inherited by rules of this policy version.

HAS_EXCLUSION.label: has exclusion
HAS_EXCLUSION.definition: Source-backed exclusion from a policy version.

APPLIES_FOR.label: applies for
APPLIES_FOR.definition: A borrower submits a credit application.

REQUESTS_PRODUCT.label: requests product
REQUESTS_PRODUCT.definition: The product requested by an application.

RESULTS_IN.label: results in
RESULTS_IN.definition: An application results in an originated loan; absence does not imply rejection.

BORROWS.label: borrows
BORROWS.definition: A borrower is a party to an originated loan.

OF_PRODUCT.label: of product
OF_PRODUCT.definition: The product type of an originated loan.

GOVERNED_BY.label: governed by
GOVERNED_BY.definition: The exact policy version governing a loan; not inferred merely from product mentions.

VERSION_OF.label: version of
VERSION_OF.definition: A policy version belongs to one stable policy identity.

PART_OF_VERSION.label: part of version
PART_OF_VERSION.definition: A section or rule belongs to exactly one policy version.

PARENT_SECTION.label: parent section
PARENT_SECTION.definition: Optional containing section within the same version.

CONTAINS_RULE.label: contains rule
CONTAINS_RULE.definition: A policy version or section contains a rule.

APPLIES_TO_SEGMENT.label: applies to segment
APPLIES_TO_SEGMENT.definition: Explicit applicability to a customer segment.

APPLIES_IN.label: applies in
APPLIES_IN.definition: Explicit geographic scope, including jurisdiction when identified as such.

MEMBER_OF_SEGMENT.label: member of segment
MEMBER_OF_SEGMENT.definition: Source-backed customer membership in a segment.

USES_METRIC.label: uses metric
USES_METRIC.definition: A rule uses a defined risk measure.

HAS_THRESHOLD.label: has threshold
HAS_THRESHOLD.definition: A rule has a numerical boundary.

MEASURED_BY.label: measured by
MEASURED_BY.definition: The metric against which a threshold is interpreted.

HAS_CONDITION.label: has condition
HAS_CONDITION.definition: The explicit logical condition for a rule, exception or approval requirement.

HAS_MEMBER.label: has member
HAS_MEMBER.definition: A logical expression contains comparison terms or nested expressions.

HAS_EXCEPTION.label: has exception
HAS_EXCEPTION.definition: A rule permits an explicitly stated exception.

EXCEPTION_TO.label: exception to
EXCEPTION_TO.definition: The one base rule from which an exception permits deviation.

IMPLEMENTED_BY_RULE.label: implemented by rule
IMPLEMENTED_BY_RULE.definition: An optional alternative rule specifies the permitted deviation.

REQUIRES_APPROVAL.label: requires approval
REQUIRES_APPROVAL.definition: A rule or exception requires a decision, not evidence that it has been granted.

REQUIRES_APPROVAL_FROM.label: requires approval from
REQUIRES_APPROVAL_FROM.definition: The role or committee required for an approval decision.

REQUIRES_EVIDENCE.label: requires evidence
REQUIRES_EVIDENCE.definition: A rule or approval requires an evidence type.

SATISFIES_REQUIREMENT.label: satisfies requirement
SATISFIES_REQUIREMENT.definition: A recorded claim that an evidence artifact satisfies a requirement; verification remains explicit.

EVIDENCE_FOR.label: evidence for
EVIDENCE_FOR.definition: An evidence artifact supports an application, rule or exception.

HAS_EFFECTIVE_PERIOD.label: has effective period
HAS_EFFECTIVE_PERIOD.definition: An explicitly stated validity period; no period implies no known validity.

DERIVED_FROM.label: derived from
DERIVED_FROM.definition: A rule is grounded in one or more exact source passages from its own policy version.

SOURCE_IN_VERSION.label: source in version
SOURCE_IN_VERSION.definition: The policy version containing an exact source passage.

CLASSIFIED_AS.label: classified as
CLASSIFIED_AS.definition: A semantic entity is classified using an external controlled taxonomy.

BINDS_TO_ATTRIBUTE.label: binds to attribute
BINDS_TO_ATTRIBUTE.definition: An explicit proposed or reviewed metric-to-data binding; never inferred from similar labels.

OPERATES_IN_INDUSTRY.label: operates in industry
OPERATES_IN_INDUSTRY.definition: The industry in which the party operates.

OPERATES_IN_GEOGRAPHY.label: operates in geography
OPERATES_IN_GEOGRAPHY.definition: A geography explicitly identified as a location of operations.

HAS_REPORTED_GEOGRAPHY.label: has reported geography
HAS_REPORTED_GEOGRAPHY.definition: Geography reported without a specific legal, booking, or risk role.

DOMICILED_IN.label: domiciled in
DOMICILED_IN.definition: The country of domicile as reported by the source.

HAS_COUNTRY_OF_RISK.label: has country of risk
HAS_COUNTRY_OF_RISK.definition: The country attributed to the party, facility, or exposure for credit-risk analysis.

IN_REGION.label: in region
IN_REGION.definition: The geography belongs to a geographic region.

BELONGS_TO_GROUP.label: belongs to group
BELONGS_TO_GROUP.definition: The party is a member of a corporate group.

HAS_PARENT_LEGAL_ENTITY.label: has parent legal entity
HAS_PARENT_LEGAL_ENTITY.definition: The identified parent organization of a party.

IN_SECTOR.label: in sector
IN_SECTOR.definition: The party or economic classification belongs to a sector.

IN_SUBSECTOR.label: in subsector
IN_SUBSECTOR.definition: The party or activity is classified in a subsector.

HAS_BUSINESS_ACTIVITY.label: has business activity
HAS_BUSINESS_ACTIVITY.definition: The activity attributed to a party or financed by a facility.

HAS_CREDIT_RATING.label: has credit rating
HAS_CREDIT_RATING.definition: A rating attributed to the party.

HAS_RISK_GRADE.label: has risk grade
HAS_RISK_GRADE.definition: A grade attributed to the party or facility.

HAS_RISK_ATTRIBUTE.label: has risk attribute
HAS_RISK_ATTRIBUTE.definition: A risk measure or characteristic, such as PD, LGD, LTV, concentration, country risk or industry risk.

HAS_RISK_OBSERVATION.label: has risk observation
HAS_RISK_OBSERVATION.definition: A measured risk value recorded in the request context.

HAS_EXPOSURE.label: has exposure
HAS_EXPOSURE.definition: An exposure attributed to the party or facility.

SUBJECT_TO_LIMIT.label: subject to limit
SUBJECT_TO_LIMIT.definition: A documented ceiling covering the exposure or facility.

REQUESTS_FACILITY.label: requests facility
REQUESTS_FACILITY.definition: A facility the borrower asks the lender to provide.

HAS_PRODUCT.label: has product
HAS_PRODUCT.definition: The product used to structure a requested or originated facility.

HAS_SPONSOR.label: has sponsor
HAS_SPONSOR.definition: A sponsor for the request or the facility.

HAS_TENOR.label: has tenor
HAS_TENOR.definition: The requested or contractual facility duration.

HAS_RECOMMENDED_TENOR.label: has recommended tenor
HAS_RECOMMENDED_TENOR.definition: A recommended facility duration recorded by the credit system.

HAS_TENANT.label: has tenant
HAS_TENANT.definition: A tenant of property financed or pledged to the facility.

BOOKED_IN_JURISDICTION.label: booked in jurisdiction
BOOKED_IN_JURISDICTION.definition: The jurisdiction in which the facility is booked.

BOOKED_AT.label: booked at
BOOKED_AT.definition: The booking office or location for the facility.

LOCATED_IN_JURISDICTION.label: located in jurisdiction
LOCATED_IN_JURISDICTION.definition: The jurisdiction of the booking location.

DENOMINATED_IN.label: denominated in
DENOMINATED_IN.definition: The recorded currency of the credit amount.

HAS_PURPOSE.label: has purpose
HAS_PURPOSE.definition: The stated purpose of the request or facility.

HAS_VERSION.label: has version
HAS_VERSION.definition: The stable policy identity has an explicitly identified version.

DERIVED_FROM_POLICY_CLASS.label: derived from policy class
DERIVED_FROM_POLICY_CLASS.definition: An explicit derivation from a policy class. Classification alone does not establish derivation.

CONCERNS.label: concerns
CONCERNS.definition: A source-backed rule subject or dependency.

REQUIRES_APPROVAL_ON_BREACH.label: requires approval on breach
REQUIRES_APPROVAL_ON_BREACH.definition: The cited approval or escalation is explicitly triggered by a threshold breach.

REQUIRES_APPROVAL_ABOVE_THRESHOLD.label: requires approval above threshold
REQUIRES_APPROVAL_ABOVE_THRESHOLD.definition: The cited approval or escalation applies above an authority or transaction threshold.

APPLIES_TO_INDUSTRY.label: applies to industry
APPLIES_TO_INDUSTRY.definition: An industry explicitly required by policy or rule scope. Full scope follows the condition logic.

APPLIES_TO_BORROWER_TYPE.label: applies to borrower type
APPLIES_TO_BORROWER_TYPE.definition: An explicit borrower type in policy or rule scope.

APPLIES_TO_SUBSECTOR.label: applies to subsector
APPLIES_TO_SUBSECTOR.definition: An expressly included economic or property subsector. Full scope follows the policy and rule conditions.

APPLIES_TO_INDUSTRY_TIER.label: applies to industry tier
APPLIES_TO_INDUSTRY_TIER.definition: An explicitly included industry risk tier.

DOCUMENTS_PRODUCT_SCOPE.label: documents product scope
DOCUMENTS_PRODUCT_SCOPE.definition: A rule statement identifies this product. Other eligibility conditions remain in the source.

COMPARES_SCOPE_VALUE.label: compares scope value
COMPARES_SCOPE_VALUE.definition: A typed value tested by a condition. The operator and its parent group determine how the comparison is used.

EVALUATES_RISK_ATTRIBUTE.label: evaluates risk attribute
EVALUATES_RISK_ATTRIBUTE.definition: The rule checks a quantitative measure or qualitative risk characteristic.

TESTS_ATTRIBUTE.label: tests attribute
TESTS_ATTRIBUTE.definition: A condition names a field with an explicit binding in the deal fact registry.

OBSERVES_DATA_ATTRIBUTE.label: observes data attribute
OBSERVES_DATA_ATTRIBUTE.definition: The observation is sourced from a registered deal attribute.

HAS_RULE_ASSESSMENT.label: has rule assessment
HAS_RULE_ASSESSMENT.definition: The credit request has a recorded rule evaluation.

ASSESSES_RULE.label: assesses rule
ASSESSES_RULE.definition: The exact rule checked in this evaluation.

HAS_OUTCOME.label: has outcome
HAS_OUTCOME.definition: The result produced by this request-specific rule evaluation.

layers.name: Domain
layers.description: Deals, parties, geography, economic classifications, facilities and risk.

layers.name: Policy
layers.description: Versioned source evidence, taxonomy, rules, thresholds, exceptions and approvals.

layers.name: Applicability
layers.description: Policy scope and rule conditions connected to domain values and deal attributes.

layers.name: Decision
layers.description: Request-specific rule evaluations and recorded outcomes.

model_sources.policy_corpus: Current policy versions, extracted rules, and reviewed policy scope records.

semantic_constraints.definition: Node and relationship IDs must be unique across the instance.
Every relationship endpoint exists and satisfies the declared domain/range, including subclass inheritance.
Every assertion and non-evidence entity references policy passages or operational evidence. Rules retain their exact source passages.
A rule and its derived source passages belong to the same policy version; source checksum/version agree.
Section/rule containment and parent-section links agree with PART_OF_VERSION.
Each threshold has one metric; its unit is permitted by that metric and the owning rule USES_METRIC.
A QUANTITATIVE rule has at least one threshold and metric.
HAS_EXCEPTION and EXCEPTION_TO agree; an implemented alternative has rule_kind EXCEPTION_RULE and shares the base version.
Membership uses a nonempty list. EXISTS omits its value. Ordered comparisons use numbers or recognized credit rating codes.
NOT has exactly one member; AND/OR have at least one; condition groups and section parents are acyclic.
An end date, when provided, cannot precede the start date.
EXAMPLE instances are synthetic and use illustrative passages; SOURCE_BACKED instances cannot cite illustrative passages.
An entity supported by synthetic source passages must itself retain the synthetic flag.

taxonomic_integration: CLASSIFIED_AS references taxonomy IDs and version; it never establishes applicability.
operational_integration: Source-backed policy versions, rules, scope and evidence populate the graph used by policy views and compliance matching.
approval_semantics: Schema conformance checks structure and consistency; it does not verify source interpretation or grant business approval.
